title: Leandro shows visitors the wrong cave for money

tellings.quote: My theory is he's been showing people this cave to make money. He charges about 3 grand

plain: Michael Mazzola, a man who looked into the three-fingered mummies said to come from Peru's Nazca region, tells of Leandro, the local man who says he found them in a cave. Mazzola says his theory is that Leandro has been showing visitors a cave, not necessarily the real one, to make money. He says Leandro charges about three thousand dollars.
